First-time setup instructions
  1. Create a Google OAuth consent screen for an external testing/internal account.
  2. Create a Web application OAuth client.
  3. Add the authorized origin and callback shown above exactly.
  4. Paste the Google Client ID and Client Secret below. The secret is never shown again.

GITHUB APP

Repository connection

Checking…

Use read-only repository access to import code for local indexing and Ollama chat. No write, issue, or pull-request permissions are used.

Callback URLLoading…
First-time setup instructions
  1. Create a GitHub App and enable user authorization.
  2. Set the callback URL shown above and enable expiring user access tokens.
  3. Grant only Metadata: read-only and Contents: read-only.
  4. Paste the GitHub App Client ID and Client Secret below. The secret stays in the OS credential manager.

PASSWORD RECOVERY

Email delivery

Checking…

Password reset is disabled until an SMTP connection is tested. Local sign-in continues to work without email.

Email setup information

Use your organization’s SMTP service or a transactional email provider. Choose STARTTLS or implicit SSL; credentials remain in the OS credential manager. This app does not include an email delivery service.
